name: Personal assistant session wrap
description: Close a personal assistant session by preserving durable outcomes and next-session continuity.

nodes.label: Collect outcomes
nodes.description: Identify artifacts, workflow runs, decisions, and task changes produced during the session.

artifact.description: Compact list of session outputs and changed durable state.

nodes.label: Separate signal
nodes.description: Distinguish durable facts from transcript noise and discard details that do not help future resumption.

artifact.description: Facts worth carrying forward, with transcript-only details omitted.

nodes.label: Update open loops
nodes.description: Classify remaining work into ready, blocked, waiting, and needs-user categories.

artifact.description: Updated open-loop classification and any user-needed decisions.

nodes.label: Write wrap note
nodes.description: Write a durable session-wrap artifact with what happened, decisions, durable changes, open loops, and next-session pointer.

artifact.description: Final wrap note suitable as the freshest input to the next session-start run.

nodes.label: Prepare next start
nodes.description: Make the next start obvious: name the first artifact or task the assistant should inspect next time.

artifact.description: Single recommended starting point for the next assistant session.
